owner_instruction_excerpt: A pair might perform badly because of resources provided and that doesn't mean demoting to the bottom of the list. A pair's rating must be evaluated if the resources provided (maybe information, skills, rules etc) are the cause the pair must not be demoted but vekl must be updated

owner_overrides.overridden: Agent's quality floor, which excluded a pair whose ledger record fell below a per-risk threshold.
owner_overrides.ruling: The evidence signal exists to build a performance hierarchy that orders assignment, not to exclude. A poor performer on a task type should not be assigned a similar task ahead of the next pair on the task-capability matching index, but is not removed from the list.
owner_overrides.effect: minimum_quality_floor is replaced by performance_hierarchy with may_exclude_pair false. BELOW_QUALITY_FLOOR is no longer a rejection reason. Ordering is comparative, so a pair with a mediocre record still wins when it is the best available match.

owner_overrides.overridden: Agent's assumption that a poor outcome is attributable to the pair.
owner_overrides.ruling: A pair may perform badly because of the resources provided — information, skills, rules. Where that is the cause the pair must not be demoted; VEKL must be updated instead.
owner_overrides.effect: Outcomes are attributed before any rating moves. Only PAIR_PERFORMANCE outcomes are rating-bearing. RESOURCE_DEFICIT leaves the rating untouched and raises a VEKL improvement signal naming the specific deficit. EXTERNAL and UNDETERMINED are also non-rating-bearing.

notes: Attribution precedence is EXTERNAL, then RESOURCE_DEFICIT, then PAIR_PERFORMANCE. A resource deficit outranks a pair-performance signal because a worker that missed an acceptance criterion it was never given has not ignored it.
An outcome with no attributing signal is UNDETERMINED and held out of the rating. Silence is not evidence against the worker.

Evidence lookup is scoped to task type via a cascade (archetype+role+risk, archetype+role, archetype, pair-global) with no fall-through to an unrelated record, so a poor showing on one archetype cannot drag the pair down on another. An earlier revision had exactly that leak and the test written for this ruling caught it.

Observed and not yet decided by the owner: because the cold-start prior is 0.75, a pair with a measured record below that ranks BELOW a pair with no record at all. That is correct Bayesian behaviour only if the prior is calibrated; it is currently an inherited constant. Recorded as a calibration note on cold_start rather than silently tuned.
